title: Rust over paint material with chipped edges
purpose: Build a painted steel node material that rusts in noise patches and in crevices found by ambient occlusion, with a thin ring of bare steel where the paint chips, and coverage, cavity weight and chip width as parameters. Use it for ships, machines, vehicles and post-industrial scenes.

parameters.name: coverage
parameters.description: How much of the surface rusts; 0 none, 1 nearly all.

parameters.name: cavity_weight
parameters.description: How strongly crevices (low ambient occlusion) attract rust.

parameters.name: ao_distance
parameters.description: Search distance of the ambient occlusion used for cavities.

parameters.name: chip_width
parameters.description: Width of the bare steel ring around rust, in units of the rust field.

parameters.name: assign
parameters.description: Assign the material to the active object.

outputs.description: One material with a node tree; assigned to the active object.

limits: The cavity term uses the Ambient Occlusion shader node, which Cycles evaluates by ray tracing and EEVEE approximates in screen space, so rust in crevices differs between them. Rust spreads by noise thresholds, not by any corrosion model, and has no streaks below edges. Rendered here with Cycles CPU only. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Nested threshold masks from one scalar field for rust and chipped paint
Ambient occlusion as a cavity mask
Mixing three Principled shaders by masks
